metadata.event_duration_scope: Whole scored windows from labeled files, not dense per-sample event annotations
metadata.event_shortage_policy: Do not replay unavailable rare events; disclose absent classes. A total event-bucket shortfall goes to English.
metadata.other_language_scope: Identified-language recordings may include JNV nonverbal or JVNV mixed material; their condition labels remain explicit
metadata.source_audio_validation: Metadata sample counts; file hash and decoded length verification required before teacher preparation
metadata.split_limit: Known source/hash/parent/speaker/session exclusions; no acoustic fingerprints or unknown-speaker guarantee

ready.scope: Metadata-complete immutable finite plan; audio revalidation remains mandatory
